mostWorthwhile.text: Returning nutrients from fallen wood to growing plants was most worthwhile: the sequence made decomposition and nutrient uptake understandable as a cycle.

leastWorthwhile.text: The opening was frustrating: the initial storm guess failed, and two inspections found no available partners before Air revealed the starting combination.

surprise.text: I was surprised that combining the renewing forest with air failed, but the compatibility feedback automatically combined it with clouds to produce forest rain.

arbitrary.text: The initial route to a storm felt somewhat opaque: clouds had no available combinations, although air and rainfall could make one. The later explanation gave that pairing a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in another chapter because the forest renewal and peat sequences connected satisfying combinations with useful explanations, despite the slow start.
